sub_limits_waiting_notes: 90 days for 3 procedures, 1 year for 5, 2 years for 19, 3 years for 4. Maternity excluded entirely.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Plan A: Room 1% of SI/day max INR 5000, ICU 2% of SI/day max INR 10000. Plan B: Room 2% of SI/day max INR 10000, ICU 4% of SI/day max INR 20000.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Less than 24 hours hospitalization at hospital/day care centre

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Both plans A & B; min 3 days; excludes alternative treatment and listed exclusions

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Plan B only - Reinstatement of SI if exhausted due to Road Traffic Accident

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Plan A: every 2 years block. Plan B: every 6 months block (with OPD consultation)

room_rent_capping: Plan A: 1% of SI per day subject to max INR 5,000. Plan B: 2% of SI per day subject to max INR 10,000. No overall limit for Plan B.
icu_capping: Plan A: 2% of SI per day max INR 10,000. Plan B: 4% of SI per day max INR 20,000.
copayment_trigger_notes: 18.5% if Zone II premium paid but availing treatment in Zone I (Gujarat, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai/Mumbai Suburban/Thane/Navi Mumbai, Nagpur, Pune). Optional: 20% copay with 25% discount or 10% copay with 12.5% discount.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract_plan_a: 15% of SI or INR 75,000 per eye, whichever lower
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospital_cash_plan_b: INR 500/day for 5 days (in excess of 3 days)

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care
Spectacles, Contact Lens, Hearing Aid, Cochlear Implants
temporary_exclusions: Specified diseases - 90 days/1 year/2 years/3 years
notable_exclusions_summary: Senior-citizen plan: NO maternity, NO infertility. Standard IRDAI exclusions plus Zone-based co-payment. 24-month PED wait (shorter than the 36-month wait on younger products).
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA (pre-auth 1 hour, final auth 3 hours). Notify cashless: 72h planned/24h emergency. Reimbursement: documents within 30 days of discharge. Claim settled in 15 days.
